What `gh-inbox` writes into today's note:

```markdown
{{< meta facts.marker.inbox_start >}}
_updated at {{< meta facts.time.job >}}_

**Waiting on you**

- [ ] [Add retry to uploader](https://github.example.com/<your-org>/<team-repo>/pull/318) · <your-org>/<team-repo> · review requested
- [ ] [Flaky deploy step](https://github.example.com/<your-org>/<team-repo>/issues/97) · <your-org>/<team-repo> · mentioned

**Oldest**

- [ ] [Document the release flow](https://github.example.com/<your-user>/<personal-repo>/issues/12) · <your-user>/<personal-repo> · assigned, 41 days

_14 more items hidden_
{{< meta facts.marker.inbox_end >}}
```

- **{{< meta facts.inbox.waiting >}}**: review requests, mentions and direct replies from the last {{< meta facts.inbox.waiting_days >}} days, at most {{< meta facts.inbox.waiting_max >}}.
- **{{< meta facts.inbox.oldest >}}**: the {{< meta facts.inbox.oldest_max >}} stalest items, to close or bump. Optional.
- One line counts the items neither list shows.
- The `updated at` stamp is the heartbeat: missing or not today's means the job didn't run.
- If today's note doesn't exist, `gh-inbox` exits with an error and doesn't create it.
